name: Chapter
funding: £3.6M income (FY2025). Arts Council of Wales core grant £681k, BFI, Cardiff Council, Welsh Government, trusts including Garfield Weston and Foyle. Gulbenkian UK Branch grant for Experimentica 2026.
watch: Community cultural hub and contemporary gallery in Cardiff.
why_flagged: £3.6M income (FY2025). Arts Council of Wales core grant £681k, BFI, Cardiff Council, Welsh Government, trusts including Garfield Weston and Foyle. Gulbenkian UK Branch grant for Experimentica 2026.
records_note: Names its ten trustees but shows two funder logos with no date; no annual reports posted, accounts for 2021 to 2025 sit on the register.

name: VISUAL
watch: Civic center for contemporary art and performance in Carlow.
records_note: No annual reports; posts 2024 financial statements and a nine-member board with appointment years; funders appear as undated logos.

name: MAIIAM
funding: Privately held by the Beurdeley-Bunnag family: Jean Michel Beurdeley, the late Patsri Bunnag and son Eric Bunnag Booth.
watch: First private contemporary art museum in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Founded by Jean Michel Beurdeley and Eric Bunnag Booth in memory of Chao Chom Iam.
records_note: The site publishes no annual reports, accounts, funder list or board; it names only the Beurdeley-Bunnag family as founders.

name: Museum of Contemporary Art Chicago (MCA)
funding: Individual donations, board giving, Northern Trust, BMO Harris, Bank of America.

name: The Renaissance Society
funding: Mellon, Teiger and Warhol foundations; Edlis Neeson, Pritzker Traubert and Zell family foundations for the Next Century Fund; Illinois Arts Council; University of Chicago, about 5 percent. FY2025 expenses $1.9M.
watch: University-based non-collecting kunsthalle; non-corporate academic funding.
records_note: Annual reports 2019-20 to 2024-25 on its site, Form 990s on ProPublica, an undated sponsors list naming funders, and 25 board members listed.

name: Pallant House Gallery
funding: £3.0M income (FY2025). Chichester District Council £130k a year to 2030, Fidelity Foundation £260k, Art Fund, patrons and bequests; Dreweatts, Evelyn Partners, Sofas & Stuff. No regular Arts Council grant.
watch: Accredited museum operating under the Museums Association Code of Ethics.
records_note: One annual review (2022-23) is online; accounts 2021 to 2025 are on the Charity Commission register; corporate partners show as logos; the board is listed.

name: Christchurch Art Gallery
funding: Christchurch City Council; the Christchurch Art Gallery Foundation raises acquisition funds. Partners are JBWere (foundation partner) and Anthony Harper (major partner), plus hotel, design and drinks suppliers.
watch: Public civic art museum in Te Wai Pounamu.
records_note: A council unit with no reports or accounts of its own; partner logos only, no board. Its Foundation files returns on the NZ register.

name: Magazzino Italian Art
watch: Museum and research center dedicated to Post-war and Contemporary Italian Art in Cold Spring, NY.
records_note: No annual reports found; Form 990-PFs for 2019 to 2023 are on ProPublica, no donor list is published, and trustees and advisors are named.

name: Museum Ludwig
funding: A museum of the City of Cologne, founded 1976 with the Peter and Irene Ludwig donation. The Ludwig Foundation, the Friends and the Gesellschaft für Moderne Kunst support it.
watch: Municipal museum governed by the City of Cologne public cultural administration.
records_note: A Cologne city museum with no report or board of its own; the city posts accounts 2008 to 2023; it names 41 partners, undated.

name: Kunsthal Charlottenborg
funding: Ministry of Culture, Statens Kunstfond and foundations including Augustinus Fonden, Det Obelske Familiefond, Ny Carlsberg, A.P. Møller, Bikuben, Knud Højgaard and William Demant.
watch: Augustinus Fonden's investment company holds over 25% of Scandinavian Tobacco Group, Obel's C.W. Obel A/S over 10% (May 2025). Both backed the 2025 programme.
records_note: Its parent academy posts annual reports for 2015 to 2025 with accounts that cover the Kunsthal, and the site lists 17 funders without a date.

name: Ny Carlsberg Glyptotek
funding: Carlsberg Foundation and Ny Carlsberg Foundation (DKK 750M each in March 2026 for restoration) plus a state operating grant. Augustinus Fonden gave DKK 1.53M in 2025 for a Gauguin purchase.
watch: Augustinus Fonden's investment arm holds over 25% of Scandinavian Tobacco Group (cigars, pipe tobacco).
why_flagged: Carlsberg Foundation and Ny Carlsberg Foundation (DKK 750M each in March 2026 for restoration) plus a state operating grant. Augustinus Fonden gave DKK 1.53M in 2025 for a Gauguin purchase.
records_note: It posts yearly reports and signed accounts for 2018 to 2025, names its board, and thanks eleven funders by name in the 2021 report.

name: Crawford Art Gallery
watch: National Cultural Institution of Ireland located in Cork.
records_note: Posts annual reports 2010 to 2024 and financial statements 2016 to 2024, lists ten board members, and names three partners with other funders by logo.
